mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees and clear out near the Military Ridge State Trail, with a first quarter moon visible, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight.

The City of Verona keeps you connected through the VHAT cable channel and their informative blog, plus you can sign up for the digital newsletter for all the latest project updates and council summaries.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus trivia all happening today, followed by live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie.
In a report from July 15th, officers responded to a residence on Prairie Oaks Drive where a man was arrested for felony bail jumping.

The flavor of the day is the delightful Really Reese's, and while the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open at 10 AM, or try the Chocolate Volcano flavor tomorrow.
